en.title: Elegy of the Azure Sky and the Slumbering Vow
en.premise: In a world afflicted by 'Meaning Erosion,' a disease where all things lose their 'definition' and turn to ash, Caelen, a former keeper of the forbidden archives, accidentally picks up a 'lost letter'—a relic from the age of gods. Within it are inscribed the only method to stop the world's collapse and a cruel promise exchanged in antiquity. To save a world on the brink of despair, Caelen embarks on a journey of memories and prayers, heading toward the 'Hill of Vow' known only in legend.

zh.title: 苍穹的挽歌与沉睡的誓约
zh.premise: 在一个万物皆失去“定义”并化为灰烬的疫病“意义侵蚀”所侵蚀的世界里，曾是禁书库看守的青年加埃伦，偶然捡到了一封神代遗物“失落的信件”。信中记录着阻止世界崩坏的唯一方法，以及远古时期许下的残酷约定。为了拯救深陷绝望边缘的世界，加埃伦踏上了前往仅存在于传说中的“约定之丘”的记忆与祈愿之旅。
